Upcoming appointment reminders

Receive a local reminder about 24 hours before a confirmed appointment. For nearer bookings, we use a later, still-future time. Very last-minute bookings may have no reminder.\n\nInternet access is needed to recheck the appointment. Android battery optimization may delay or prevent delivery; reminders are not exact.
